<thought>We need to return all possible precursors when applying template 1914398 to the target molecule. The template’s mapped reaction shows that the product is formed from bromine (Br) and a nitro‑substituted bicyclic aromatic compound. Therefore the precursors are the bromine atom and the nitro‑containing scaffold without the bromine. The SMILES for the nitro scaffold (with atom mapping removed) is approximated as O=[N+]([O-])c1c(cc2c(c1)CC C1(CC C1)O2). Thus the list of precursor combinations is a single list containing these two SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[['O=[N+]([O-])c1c(cc2c(c1)CC C1(CC C1)O2)', 'Br']]</final_answer>
